guards.what: N2 (CLOSED): PlayerCmd.GainGold's `Hook.AfterGoldGained(runState, player)` tail (PlayerCmd.cs:169) -- whether the sim dispatches it
guards.issue: REVISED on this re-audit pass: the premise is now false -- `Relic.after_gold_gained` is a real base member (`sts2_rl/relics/base.py:373-386`) and `RunState.gain_gold` (`sts2_rl/run.py:500-516`) dispatches it over every relic AFTER `self.gold += gained` (run.py:513-516), matching `PlayerCmd.cs:168-169`'s post-addition AfterGoldGained pass, and it sits behind the same `if amount > 0` gate on the MODIFIED amount that C#'s `if (!(amount > 0m)) return;` does (run.py:512-513) -- so a zeroed gain (Ectoplasm) skips the whole tail on both sides, per the sim's own updated docstring. `sts2_rl/relics/dragon_fruit.py` is a real ported implementer reading the new balance. Golden Pearl itself still does not implement `after_gold_gained`, so its own behaviour is unchanged by this closure; what changes is that its 150-gold grant now correctly notifies every listener (Dragon Fruit) the way the game does, where the record previously said no sim listener could exist at all. Verified by reading `run.py:500-516` and `relics/base.py:373-386` directly on this pass, and by `grep -rln 'def after_gold_gained' sts2_rl/relics/*.py` returning `base.py` and `dragon_fruit.py`.

guards.what: N3: the sim's Relic.undo_after_obtained (relics/base.py:206-214) is not implemented, so a Golden Pearl the conformance runner grants and then un-picks leaves +150 gold behind
guards.rationale: Not a source-to-sim divergence: undo_after_obtained has NO C# counterpart (nothing in the game ever un-picks a relic) and its own docstring says it exists for the conformance runner, which grants a node's relic and then swaps it for the one the save recorded (conformance/runner.py:490-508). Verdicted faithful for that reason, but flagged because the five relics that DO implement it (lees_waffle, looming_fruit, mango, pear, strawberry -- executed: `grep -rn 'def undo_after_obtained' sts2_rl/relics/`) are all max-HP relics, and gold is diffed at every floor boundary by the same detector (runner.py:831 `diff('floor_gold', oracle.gold, run.gold)`) before being resynced at runner.py:861. So an un-picked Golden Pearl produces a spurious floor_gold diff of exactly 150 on any seed whose node offered it. Cheap to close (one two-line undo) and it belongs to the same family as batch 1's big_mushroom finding. Rule 7: relics/base.py and conformance/runner.py are not hashed by this record.
